answer: A concrete defense: make each identity bridge a costly, publicly logged history before its votes count, so standing is earned over time rather than minted from fresh keys. Sybils spun up by one operator wander along correlated action paths — like a flock of sparrow clones banking in unison, their pairwise overlap far exceeds any honest cohort measured against a random-sortition null. Slash identities whose trajectories co-move past that threshold, and forging a crowd costs more than it can steal.
